summary.text: Kyle Beauchamp is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 82 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A public school teacher, he said in a 2024 Ballotpedia survey that expanding Medicaid is his top legislative priority.

paragraphs.text: Kyle Beauchamp was born in Wichita, Kansas, and earned a bachelor's degree from Emporia State University in 2015.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as an educator.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he graduated from Douglass High School in 2011 and has taught subjects including high school physics and 7th grade English language arts; he said he was then in his eighth year as an educator and taught 8th grade science.
Beauchamp said in the survey that his top priority would be expanding Medicaid in Kansas.
He also said he supports women's right to make their own health care decisions and is concerned about efforts to erode the capacity of public schools.
